title: Baby Sitting on Blanket Outdoors with Stuffed Bunny, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1950s snapshot of a young baby sitting on a blanket laid out on a lawn in a garden. Beside the baby rests a plush stuffed rabbit toy. In the background are irises and garden plants, capturing an intimate moment of mid-century American suburban family life.
